messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC12345 auto-page fired in #incidents - HTTP 5xx rate > 8% (prod-eu-west1). Alerting: gateway.http.5xx_rate > 8% for 2m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 assigned to raj (oncall).

raj (oncall): acked. looking. any obvious deployments? :eyes:

sophia: not aware of any deploys in the last hour. grafana: <https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd|prod-eu-west1 5xx-rate> shows a sharp spike starting ~10:02 UTC.

eli: curl to edge gateway returns 504 consistently from my laptop. trying direct to origin service (inference-gateway): `curl -v https://inference-gw.eu-west1.redwood/api/health` gets long hang then 504.

marta: checking k8s autoscaler in eu-west1. there was a scale-up event at 09:59 UTC but pods kept restarting. suspect OOM or liveness flapping.

ops-runbooks: runbooks: see section "5xx spike - gateway upstream" -> steps 1-4. start with `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` and tail pod logs.

raj (oncall): running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference-gateway -o wide` now.

raj (oncall): ```
NAME                                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE
inference-gw-7f6d8f5b6-2k9hz             1/1     Running   7          6h    10.12.3.45   gke-eu-1
inference-gw-7f6d8f5b6-8pqls             1/1     Running   12         6h    10.12.3.46   gke-eu-2
inference-gw-7f6d8f5b6-z9xq2             0/1     CrashLoop 34         6h    10.12.3.47   gke-eu-3
```

raj (oncall): one pod is CrashLoopBackOff, rest have high restarts. logs show repeated `kvcache allocation failed` and then `runtime: goroutine stack exceeds limit` around the time of spike.

eli: looks like memory growth on the gateway process. any recent config changes to prefix caching or batching?

marta: ops-alert: we rotated a configmap for `gateway-batching` at 09:55 but it was supposed to be a noop. pushing rollback now.

raj (oncall): rolling back configmap `gateway-batching` to revision -1. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-gateway -n inference` in progress.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 acknowledged by raj (oncall).

incident-bot: Note: auto-repage logic enabled. Will re-evaluate every 5m if metric still > threshold.

sophia: rollback applied, rolling restart finished. but 5xx rate only briefly dipped to ~5% then climbed again.

eli: I see many 504s correlate with `keepalive: connection reset by peer` from upstream NLB. Might be socket exhaustion. checking system network stats.

marta: scaling up node pool in eu-west1 by +3 nodes as a precaution (gke autoscaler didn't react quickly). ETA ~4m.

raj (oncall): adding temporary route rule to circuit-break clients after 3 consecutive 5xx to avoid cascade. Pushing config patch to gateway: `circuit_breaker: consecutive_5xx: 3`

ops-runbooks: reminder: update incident severity and customer impact in pagerduty if >5% of requests are affected.

sophia: quick customer impact check: kpi-dashboard shows 7% of total requests failing in eu-west1; top 10 API keys: two enterprise customers seeing 40% request failure. raising SEV2?

eli: PagerDuty auto-resolved then re-fired twice in the last 10m. looks like an ack-loop: PagerDuty incident is acknowledged but a secondary alert group re-triggers new pages because of duplicate alert key (alert dedup bug).

raj (oncall): confirmed. I saw two additional pages while I was in the middle of rollback. annoying but we're tracking.

marta: I can temporarily mute the autopage for this alert on PagerDuty until stable - that will stop noise to oncall but keep the incident in PD. Want me to do it?

raj (oncall): yes please mute autopage for `gateway.http.5xx_rate` for 30m. leave PD incident active.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: autopage muted for rule gateway.http.5xx_rate by marta for 30m.

eli: after node scale and circuit-breaker patch, 5xx rate dropped to ~3.2% around 10:18 UTC. still seeing intermittent 504s from one node (10.12.3.47).

raj (oncall): cordon and drain 10.12.3.47 to remove flapping pod from rotation. `kubectl cordon gke-eu-3 && kubectl drain gke-eu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

raj (oncall): drained, pod rescheduled to new node and is stable. 5xx rate now ~1.1%.

sophia: pushing postmortem note: suspect combination of configmap change + a runaway memory pattern in the gateway causing socket exhaustion. we'll follow up with an eval on batching config.

eli: PD note: acknowledge loop root cause: duplicate dedup-key generation by our alert-processor on high-cardinality metric spikes. I filed a ticket (ENG-9876) to fix dedup logic.

marta: updating customers: SOC/SEs on rotation notified top affected customers at 10:28 UTC. no SLA breaches confirmed yet but we're tracking.

ops-runbooks: mark incident status -> mitigated. leave incident open for full postmortem and code fix.

raj (oncall): handing off to sophia (next oncall) for follow-up and postmortem. leaving notes: rollback configmap, scaled nodes +3, cordoned gke-eu-3, enabled circuit-breaker temporary threshold, muted autopage until fix.

sophia: ack handoff. I'll own the postmortem and link the logs/graphs. Closing chat loop here — will post draft postmortem in #postmortems later today. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 status updated -> mitigated.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 auto-resolve triggered by metric normalization.

raj (oncall): note: PD re-fires if metric spikes again. retaining monitoring watch for next 2 hours.

sophia: thanks all. good run. we should triage ENG-9876 (dedup) and add a chaos test for configmap rollouts.

marta: adding to roadmap and scheduling a follow-up with infra/alerts team.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from eli, :raised_hands: from marta)
